international.title: Marlboro maker Altria considering takeover bid for Imperial Brands
international.summary: Shares in UK tobacco company jump by more than 14% on news US rival is looking into making offer Business live – latest updates Imperial Brands could become the next UK company to fall to a foreign takeover after its US rival Altria announced a possible bid for the tobacco firm. Altria, whose Philip Morris division makes Marlboro and Benson & Hedges cigarettes, told the City on Thursday that it was considering an offer. If made it was likely to be solely in cash, it said.
